query:
SELECT (t.state = 'open'
                       AND (t.grant_id IS NULL
                            OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM grants b
                                       WHERE b.id = t.grant_id AND b.status = 'active'
                                         AND b.expires_at > $2))) AS "open!"
               FROM a2a_threads t WHERE t.id = $1 FOR SHARE OF t
